decision: GOVERNANCE.md, approvals log, 2026-11-05, the row "The hook-round count of the damped trace parity" (the author, S M Shovan); ADR 0100
what: The values of the trace field connected_components.hook_rounds (the Shiloach-Vishkin hook rounds of the damped trace) that LabelPropagation-CUDA@a276a3a's own runs produce, per case of P+ and batch: the trace golden's value and every value of the original's recorder twin (its unchanged objects) in the source record's fresh runs. The fused engine's damped replay accepts a port value of this field that is in the set of its case and batch (and only when the golden's value is in it too); a case or batch not listed here accepts the golden's value only, and every other trace field stays exact. The sets are derived from the sources (parity/label_propagation_port.py original_values_problems checks it; certify.py checks the replays against this file).
